name: professional-agenda
description: Professional agenda and appointment scheduling system

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:backend:tests && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
